    # Create more webhooks than max_results

    for i in range(5):

            name=f"webhook{i}",

    assert len(webhooks_page) == 2
    assert webhooks_page.token is not None
    # Get next page

    assert len(next_webhooks_page) == 2
    assert next_webhooks_page.token is not None
